nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

filter.description: Filter conditions, multiple conditions separated by commas; see the table below for valid values

imageBase64.description: Pure Base64 encoding, does not contain `data:image/jpeg;base64,` prefix; only supports png/jpg/jpeg; choose one of `imageUrl` and `imageId`

imageId.description: 1688 picture ID; it is recommended to carry `page>1` when paging, which can speed up the response; choose one of three `imageUrl` and `imageBase64`

imageUrl.description: Image URL, maximum length 1000; only supports png/jpg/jpeg; choose one of `imageBase64`, `imageId`

keyword.description: Keywords to further search in the results

pageSize.description: The number of products per page cannot exceed 50

priceEnd.description: Price filter end value (RMB), such as `100`

priceStart.description: Price filter starting value (RMB), such as `10`

productCollectionId.description: Pallet ID, single choice; see the table below for valid values

sort.description: JSON format `{sort field: sorting method}`; valid fields are `price`, `monthSold`, `rePurchaseRate`
